scope: Bounded issuer, pharmacy and claims discovery followed by conditional cohort calibration. No bulk collection, paid data, outreach or agents.

GAP1.finding: 74.4%paid share; more than60%of paid users remain at least one year. Absolute current denominator not disclosed.
GAP1.model_use: Qualitative consistency of61%first-year benchmark; payment mix is independently important. Not a paid-start conversion cohort.

GAP2.finding: 2021–2024claims;3647patients ever on HAE treatment; annual any-LTP claim share64%to68%.
GAP2.model_use: 68%central proxy for LTP among treated in a provisional partition,60–70%assumed sensitivity. Not current population or exclusive point-in-time shares.
GAP2.limitations: Selected insured sample; standardized dispensing quantity changes do not equal patient share changes.6,715prevalence estimate is census/prevalence-derived, not a newly observed patient census.

GAP3.finding: 1702USstart forms throughFeb28; majorityQ4revenuefromrefills; no aligned paid patient count.
GAP3.model_use: No valid paid-conversion estimate; do not infer it from revenue/forms.

GAP4.location: Access and product support / launch metrics
GAP4.finding: QuickStart, assistance and bridge services; paid prescriptions identified as a launch metric but no paired numerical referral-to-paid cohort in retrieved material.
GAP4.model_use: Distinguish referral, free shipment, paid shipment and repeat paid supply.
